ITEM 1 | Pile of dark green leafy greens with flat, smooth, slightly glossy leaves and thin pale stems, lightly wilted and coated with a faint sheen, spread across the center-left of the plate, roughly 14 cm by 12 cm footprint, about 3 to 4 cm tall in a loose mound | 95
ITEM 2 | Small granular cluster of tan-orange grains with some darker brown bits, scattered over the top of the greens in the center, dry and crumbly with a slightly matte surface, covering about 4 cm by 4 cm, about 1 cm thick | 18
ITEM 3 | Two thin wedges of bright red fruit with a glossy, smooth skin and pale pinkish-white interior edges, sitting at the right edge of the greens, each wedge about 3 cm long and 1 cm wide, firm and moist-looking | 22
